content.title: About
content.content: Fruit Nectar NFS is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from concentrated fruit juice diluted with water and lightly sweetened. It offers a rich, aromatic flavor without artificial colors or flavors.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS stands for “Natural Fruit Syrup,” a term used in beverage production.
The nectar retains most of the vitamins and minerals of the original fruits thanks to gentle heat processing.
Unlike pure juice, nectar has a longer shelf life without the need for preservatives.
The NFS range includes orange, apple, berry blend, and tropical fruit variants.
PET bottle packaging provides easy transport and recyclability.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Fruit nectar is rich in vitamin C, which supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: High water content helps maintain the body’s fluid balance, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: A small amount of soluble fiber aids normal digestion.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Simple sugars quickly replenish energy stores, making it convenient after physical activity.

items.title: Rich fruit aroma
items.content: Natural aromatic compounds enhance taste and can improve mood.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Nectar contains added sugar, so people with diabetes or weight concerns should limit intake.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to specific fruits may react to nectar made from those fruits.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Highly acidic variants (e.g., citrus) may irritate the stomach lining if consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Nectar is ready to drink straight from the bottle. It can be enjoyed chilled, used in cocktails, mixed with water 1:1, or added to desserts and sauces.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the nectar in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
